name: IC 1776, SN 2015ap field (Hubble)
blurb: IC 1776, a galaxy that hosted the Type Ib supernova SN 2015ap, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2015ap-hubble
story: SN 2015ap, a stripped-envelope Type Ib supernova whose early light showed strong helium lines, went off in this galaxy. Hubble returned to the quiet site long after the blast faded.

claims.text: SN 2015ap is a Type Ib supernova
Early spectra of SN 2015ap show prominent helium lines
Hubble program 16024 imaged the site of SN 2015ap
